basics.name: Harvey Luna
basics.label: Operations Manager
basics.summary: Operations Manager at The Addy Foundation Center on Research & Evaluation (CORE) at Southern Methodist University. Experienced in data analytics, public policy, team development, organizational design, and mixed methods research. Coordinates international teacher professional development and manages evaluation and data collection efforts for educational projects.

work.name: Southern Methodist University - Center on Research & Evaluation (CORE)
work.summary: Operations Manager at The Addy Foundation Center on Research & Evaluation (CORE). Coordinates international teacher professional development for the Galápagos project, engaging with the Galapagos Conservancy and Ecuadorian Ministry of Education. Manages evaluation and data collection efforts for projects involving over 300 teachers and school administrators.
highlights: Manages evaluation and data collection for projects with 300+ teachers and administrators
Coordinates international teacher professional development in Galápagos
Partners with Galapagos Conservancy and Ecuadorian Ministry of Education
